key_insight: Equivariant MLIPs can be scaled into fast, accurate foundation models by optimizing architecture and training infrastructure, even on ultra-large datasets where data efficiency matters less.
engineering_relevance: This enables practical molecular dynamics and materials workflows that need both high throughput and strong accuracy, while reducing the cost of training and inference.
method: Built foundation potentials using equivariant NequIP and Allegro architectures to encode physical symmetries directly.
Improved NequIP infrastructure to accelerate training on ultra-large datasets.
Benchmarked the models across materials discovery, thermal conductivity, and near-equilibrium mechanical/thermodynamic tasks.
evidence_signal: The models are reported to achieve leading inference speed, strong scalability, and excellent accuracy across multiple community benchmarks.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on high-quality, diverse training data, and materials discovery accuracy still appears sensitive to consistent treatment of transition-metal energy surfaces.
paper_title: Fast and Accurate Foundation Models for Equivariant Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
